attributes.name: phone number prominence as contact mechanism
attributes.definition: How prominently a telephone number is used on the page as the way to contact the business.

values.definition: The phone number is the main call to action, standing in for buttons or forms.
The phone number recurs in several page regions (e.g. header, CTA band, footer) as an always-available contact.
The phone number appears once or in a minor way.

attributes.name: repetition of phone number across page
attributes.definition: Whether the phone number is repeated in multiple places on the page.

values.definition: The number appears in two or more distinct page regions.
The number appears in only one place.

attributes.name: lead capture form and button CTAs
attributes.definition: Whether the page offers form fields or button-styled calls to action for conversion.

values.definition: Page includes form fields and/or button-styled CTAs.
No form fields or button-styled CTAs; conversion relies on phone number.
Page may have these but it is not asserted.
